## Purpose

The laboratory workflow begins with **18 consented participants** distributed across three clinical groups: 8 high-risk ulcerative colitis, 5 colorectal cancer, and 5 healthy comparators. This is the biological sample size; downstream reads and technical replicates do not enlarge it.

| Input | Process | Output |
|---|---|---|
| consent and eligibility documentation | assign de-identified participant ID; record group and covariates | controlled participant manifest |
| blood and colonic biopsy collection events | bind specimen IDs to the participant | tissue/plasma/serum linkage table |
| three laboratory technical replicates | bind replicate and batch IDs below each specimen | replicate-aware processing manifest |

```text
participant_id  group    specimen  replicate  collection_event  batch
P001            UC       plasma    1          C001              B1
P001            UC       tissue    1          C001              B1
P001            UC       serum     1          C001              E1
```

## QC gate

Consent scope, eligibility, specimen identity, pairing, collection time, missingness, and protocol deviations must be resolved before molecular results are exposed. Public artifacts use de-identified IDs only.

::: {.callout-note title="What this stage generates"}
This protocol generates **metadata**, not a biomarker: the authoritative key connecting every tube, library, ELISA well, clinical group, and final participant-level row.
:::
